The reference shelf face is viewed obliquely and the bed occludes its lower-left region; the candidate presents a more head-on shelf with separation above the bed. Camera, depth placement and field of view can all contribute, so no unique layout correction follows (reference and candidate attachments; final_source/build.py:28-34,79-80).

The candidate chair shell faces the bedward direction according to its profile, but the cropped reference chair and the nearly symmetric shelf and lamps limit absolute orientation inference. GT and student transforms have no established shared frame (final_source/build.py:63-71; input_index.json:33).

The source's mat creates default node-enabled Principled materials and assigns base color, roughness and metallic; Table wood binds to Bedside table top while separate Picture frame pale wood strips create grain. No image texture, coordinate mapping, noise, or ramp is constructed by this source; no directional shader helper is used (final_source/build.py:6-10,42-48).

Floor grout is explicit mesh geometry; lighting combines two warm point sources, a large area source and a colored world (final_source/build.py:24-27,57-62,76-78). Original evaluator summary reports no missing external images (original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:2-7). The scene is geometric rather than a full-reference image plane (final_source/build.py:18-85).
geometry_analysis: The reference has a textured thick mattress and a shelf whose lower area is partly obscured. Student uses a beveled mattress box and a regular six-column, four-row grid with crossing boards (final_source/build.py:28-34; reference and candidate attachments).
The right wall is a solid cube and Dark door opening is a thin dark cube placed against it, so it is not evidence of a cut opening or coherent hinged door (final_source/build.py:22,72-73).

The chair shell is a subdivided, solidified profile with four straight legs, whereas the GT object is identified as a swivel chair; the reference hides its base, so base geometry cannot be judged from the image alone (final_source/build.py:63-71; reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:337-351). AABB overlaps do not prove physical contact or penetration (original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:8-15).
